gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-noto-trad: Adventurous and tall, with letters strolling far apart. Noto Traditional Nushu is the quieter one, a broad-nibbed sans whose bowls fill the line, while Eight Bit Dragon gets the bold, showy work.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-numans: Numans spreads out with hanging s ends and tightly coiled, swollen lowercase, all pushed wide by generous tracking. And Eight Bit Dragon strides in beside it, tall and bold, with arches that thin just slightly off the stem.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-onest: Widely separated letters and a towering lowercase give Eight Bit Dragon its relaxed, adventurous stride. But Onest keeps the sans-serif text modest, with short ascenders over big bowls and strokes that never change thickness.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-open-sans: Eight Bit Dragon strides across the line with widely separated letters and a towering lowercase. And Open Sans handles the smooth reading, a bulky sans with no clogged curves, leaving the heading's slightly shifting stroke weights to do the showing off.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-orienta: Orienta has counters that breathe, nearly equal in height across cases.  Eight Bit Dragon brings an adventurous, towering stride beside it, and the pair's strongest quality is texture: light strokes recede only slightly in the heading while the sans-serif text stays quiet.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-oxygen: Tall lowercase and a relaxed, widely spaced stride mark Eight Bit Dragon, with a mild taper where strokes bend. And Oxygen, a plain sans with curves that never close back on themselves, leaves the big, short lines to the heading.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-parkinsan: Adventurous from the first glance, Eight Bit Dragon spaces its towering lowercase wide and thickens its stems just a touch. Parkinsans, a plain sans, draws one stroke thickness everywhere and stays crisp when shrunk, which is where it does its best work.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-pathway-e: Pathway Extreme reads with clear openings in its rounded letters, stubby ascenders, and a big x-height. And Eight Bit Dragon stands over it as a tall, adventurous heading whose slight heft change recalls stone-carved inscription beside that plain sans.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-preahvihe: Preahvihear reads open and lofty, like a pried oyster shell. Eight Bit Dragon does the bold, adventurous talking with fuller stems and slimmer links, while that plain sans handles the steady everyday reading.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-pt-sans-c: PT Sans Caption has inviting, unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase. Its strongest quality is how it lets Eight Bit Dragon stay adventurous and towering, with a mild pen-like swing in its strokes, while the sans keeps everything else easygoing.
